physicalNotes: Radius 0.7511 +/- 0.0346 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1443 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 522,540 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.7663 +/- 0.0234 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1443 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5224 +/- 59 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1443 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
